items.title: SIP (Systematic Investment Plan)
items.description: An investment method where you invest a fixed amount at regular intervals (weekly, monthly, quarterly) to build wealth gradually and reduce market timing risk.

items.title: Goal Tracking
items.description: Monitor your SIP progress towards specific financial goals with automatic performance calculations and projected completion dates.

items.title: Rupee Cost Averaging
items.description: A strategy where regular fixed investments buy more units when prices are low and fewer when prices are high, potentially lowering your average cost per unit.

items.title: Financial Goals
items.description: Specific, measurable targets like retirement, education, house purchase, or vacation with timelines and funding strategies.

items.title: Goal Priority
items.description: Categorize and rank your financial goals by importance and urgency to allocate resources more effectively.

items.title: Goal Progress
items.description: Real-time tracking of your savings and investments against each goal with projections on whether you'll meet your targets on time.

items.title: Net Worth Summary
items.description: A comprehensive overview of your total wealth calculated from all accounts, investments, and physical assets minus any liabilities.

items.title: Quick Actions
items.description: Shortcuts to frequently used features like adding accounts, creating goals, and accessing recent transactions for faster navigation.

items.title: Financial Insights
items.description: AI-powered recommendations and alerts based on your spending patterns, investment performance, and financial health metrics.

items.title: Credit Score Range
items.description: A score between 300-900 that indicates your creditworthiness based on payment history, credit utilization, and other factors used by lenders.

items.title: CIBIL/Bureau Score
items.description: Credit information bureau score that tracks your loan and credit card repayment history, defaults, and credit inquiries.

items.title: Score Factors
items.description: Key components affecting your credit score including payment history (35%), credit utilization (30%), length of credit history (15%), and credit mix (20%).

items.title: Tax Deductions
items.description: Eligible expenses and investments that reduce your taxable income such as 80C investments, HRA, medical expenses, and interest on home loans.

items.title: Tax Liability
items.description: The total amount of income tax you owe to the government based on your annual income, deductions, and applicable tax slabs.

items.title: ITR Filing
items.description: Income Tax Return filing status and guidance for reporting your annual income, savings, and tax obligations to the income tax department.

items.title: Personalized Recommendations
items.description: AI-generated investment, savings, and financial planning suggestions based on your profile, goals, risk tolerance, and spending patterns.

items.title: Risk Assessment
items.description: Evaluation of your financial risk profile considering income stability, goals timeline, and existing portfolio to suggest appropriate investment strategies.

items.title: Confidence Score
items.description: A measure indicating how relevant and reliable each recommendation is based on data completeness, market conditions, and historical accuracy.

items.title: Scenario Simulation
items.description: Test different financial decisions like changing investment amounts, retirement age, or spending patterns to see projected outcomes.

items.title: Market Conditions
items.description: Adjust assumptions about inflation rates, market returns, and economic factors to understand how various scenarios affect your wealth.

items.title: Projection Timeline
items.description: Year-by-year visualization of how your net worth, investments, and savings will grow under different assumptions and decisions.

items.title: Account Aggregator (AA)
items.description: A secure consent-based system that fetches your financial data from multiple banks and institutions to provide a unified view of your finances.

items.title: Consent Management
items.description: Control what data is shared, with whom, and for how long through explicit consent revocation, ensuring your privacy and data security.

items.title: Linked Institutions
items.description: Banks and financial institutions you've authorized through Account Aggregator to share your transaction and account information with WealthVault.

items.title: Family Members
items.description: Add and manage profiles of family members with role-based permissions to share financial information and collaborate on financial planning.

items.title: Shared Goals
items.description: Create and track collective family financial goals like vacation, education fund, or emergency corpus with combined savings tracking.

items.title: Family Dashboard
items.description: Unified view of family finances with aggregated assets, liabilities, and wealth distribution across family members with privacy controls.

items.title: Profile Management
items.description: Update personal information, contact details, notification preferences, and profile picture for your WealthVault account.

items.title: Security Settings
items.description: Configure two-factor authentication, password management, security questions, and device trust settings to protect your account.

items.title: Privacy Preferences
items.description: Control data sharing, communication frequency, marketing preferences, and choose what information is visible to family members.

items.title: Active Sessions
items.description: List of all devices and browsers currently logged into your WealthVault account with session timestamps and locations.

items.title: Session Management
items.description: Ability to terminate any active session remotely to ensure unauthorized access is immediately stopped.

items.title: Device Recognition
items.description: List of trusted devices that don't require additional verification on login and unrecognized devices for security alerts.

items.title: Help Center
items.description: Comprehensive documentation, tutorials, and FAQs covering all WealthVault features and common user issues.

items.title: Ticket Support
items.description: Submit support tickets for issues, feature requests, or account problems with real-time status tracking and priority levels.

items.title: Chat Support
items.description: Live chat with support agents available during business hours for immediate assistance with urgent account or technical issues.

items.title: Frequently Asked Questions
items.description: Curated list of most common user questions categorized by topic with detailed answers and troubleshooting steps.

items.title: Search & Filter
items.description: Quickly find answers by searching keywords or browsing by categories like account setup, security, investments, and billing.

items.title: Related Articles
items.description: Additional helpful resources and related questions to give you comprehensive understanding of various WealthVault features.

items.title: Privacy Policy
items.description: Complete details about how WealthVault collects, uses, stores, and protects your personal and financial data in compliance with regulations.

items.title: Data Encryption
items.description: Your financial data is encrypted both in transit (SSL/TLS) and at rest using military-grade encryption standards for maximum security.

items.title: Data Rights
items.description: Your rights to access, correct, delete, or port your data as per DPDP and other privacy regulations with transparent disclosure.

items.title: User Accounts
items.description: Complete list of all registered users with their KYC status, account creation date, last login, and account verification status.

items.title: User Roles & Permissions
items.description: Define and manage user access levels (Admin, Manager, User) with granular permissions for different sections and operations.

items.title: Account Actions
items.description: Manage user accounts including suspension, activation, verification, and communication through admin interface with audit logs.

items.title: KYC Status
items.description: Know Your Customer verification status of users including Pending, Approved, Rejected, and Expired with submission timestamps.

items.title: Document Verification
items.description: Admin review of submitted identity and address proof documents with ability to approve, reject, or request resubmission.

items.title: Verification Queue
items.description: Prioritized queue of pending KYC submissions with bulk processing options and automated compliance check results.

items.title: Document Review
items.description: Detailed examination of submitted KYC documents including PAN, Aadhaar, address proof with image quality and data validation checks.

items.title: Compliance Checks
items.description: Automated verification against sanction lists, PEP databases, and regulatory requirements with manual override capability for edge cases.

items.title: Review Comments
items.description: Add comments, notes, and communicate specific feedback to users about KYC status, rejections, or additional documentation requirements.

items.title: Loan Applications
items.description: Dashboard of all loan applications with statuses (Pending, Approved, Rejected, Disbursed) and application details for review.

items.title: Loan Disbursement
items.description: Process of transferring approved loan amounts to borrower accounts with transaction records and disbursement status tracking.

items.title: Repayment Tracking
items.description: Monitor loan repayment schedules, EMI payments, defaults, and outstanding balances across all active loans with payment history.

items.title: Suspicious Transactions
items.description: Automated alerts for unusual account activity, high-value transfers, location anomalies, and transactions flagged by risk models.

items.title: Fraud Rules
items.description: Configurable rules and thresholds for fraud detection including velocity limits, amount limits, and behavioral anomalies.

items.title: Investigation Tools
items.description: Admin interface to review flagged transactions, verify legitimacy, block/unblock accounts, and maintain fraud investigation logs.

items.title: User Metrics
items.description: Key performance indicators including active users, new registrations, churn rate, average account value, and engagement metrics.

items.title: Financial Insights
items.description: Aggregated financial data showing total assets under management, transaction volumes, investment distribution, and portfolio composition.

items.title: Trend Analysis
items.description: Historical trends and comparative analytics showing month-over-month, quarter-over-quarter growth and performance against targets.

items.title: Audit Trail
items.description: Complete record of all system activities including user logins, transactions, data modifications, and admin actions with timestamps.

items.title: Log Filters
items.description: Filter and search audit logs by user, action type, date range, or transaction ID for compliance and security investigations.

items.title: Data Integrity
items.description: Immutable audit logs that ensure accountability, detect unauthorized access, and provide evidence for compliance audits and investigations.

items.title: KYC Documents
items.description: Submit identity proof (PAN, Aadhaar), address proof (electricity bill, rental agreement), and income documentation for verification.

items.title: Document Requirements
items.description: Clear guidelines on accepted document types, file formats (PDF, JPG), file sizes, and image quality standards for successful submission.

items.title: Submission Status
items.description: Real-time tracking of KYC submission status with notifications on approval, rejection, or if additional documents are requested.

items.title: Alert Types
items.description: Various security alerts including login from new device, suspicious activity, failed login attempts, and permission changes.

items.title: Alert Actions
items.description: Quick response options to security alerts like confirming login legitimacy, blocking transactions, or changing password immediately.

items.title: Alert History
items.description: Complete history of all security alerts with timestamps, details, and actions taken to help you monitor account security.

items.title: Registration Requirements
items.description: Basic information needed for account creation including email, mobile number, password, and personal details for account setup.

items.title: Email & SMS Verification
items.description: Verification links sent to email and OTP sent to registered mobile number to confirm your contact information and secure your account.

items.title: Terms & Conditions
items.description: Important legal agreements and policies you must accept before registration, including privacy policy and user agreement.

items.title: Two-Factor Authentication
items.description: Additional security layer requiring OTP via SMS or authenticator app along with password for enhanced account protection against unauthorized access.

items.title: Forgot Password
items.description: Recovery process for forgotten passwords using email verification, security questions, or other identity verification methods.

items.title: Session Management
items.description: Login session creation and management with automatic timeout for inactivity, single session enforcement, or multi-device access options.
